comparison.objective: Remove the internal burr from a cut copper tube using a hand reamer without over-chamfering it.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a tube, coaxially insert a conical tool, apply controlled rotational passes, regrasp, and avoid over-processing.
comparison.success_condition: All bore sectors are adequately reamed, none over-chamfered, tube returned to its rack, tool removed, and both released stably.
comparison.reason: PR-2244 tests rotational material removal with dose control. The candidate tests selective particle passage and workpiece retention in a manipulated screen; shared bimanual holding and reseating do not make the tested abilities equivalent.
